project_tracker_diagnostic: Deciduous red oak with 7–9 deeply cut lobes ending in sharp bristle/awn tips; glossy mostly glabrous leaves; biennial acorns.
verified_target_counties: Hays; Travis; Blanco; Burnet; Comal; Gillespie; Kerr; Bandera; Edwards; Real; Uvalde; Williamson; Kendall

morphology_keys.bark: Gray and smooth to black and furrowed.
morphology_keys.leaves: Broadly elliptic to obovate/circular; usually 7–9 lobes; lobe tips acute to acuminate with numerous awns/bristles; surfaces mostly glabrous and often glossy.
morphology_keys.acorn: Biennial; cup usually goblet- to cup-shaped and covers roughly one-third to one-half of the nut.

photo_strategy.oak_specific_tightening: Prioritize multi-photo late-summer/fall observations to increase the chance of mature leaves and acorns, plus curated taxon reference photos.
